purpose: Map external metadata and preservation concepts to the FR-0333 Creative Ownership dictionary without treating standards as ownership adjudication or silently changing canonical claims.
review_gate: Open compatibility review only when a published change affects mapped fields, serialization, validation, signatures, package fixity, or preservation-assessment interpretation. Editorial changes/no mapped impact are REFERENCE + STAY.

tabs.title: Field Map
tabs.summary: Standards are reference inputs. They do not rewrite FR-0333 identity, ownership assertions, promotion rules, or historical records.

tabs.title: DCMI Metadata Terms
defined: DCMI term URIs, labels, definitions, term type, and specified domain/range
tabs.implication: Descriptive vocabulary only; it does not adjudicate ownership. Preserve term URIs and value semantics. Review if definitions, identifiers, ranges, or recommended encoding practices alter a mapped field.
tabs.status: DCMI Metadata Terms is listed as a current DCMI Recommendation; current release identified as 2020-01-20.

tabs.title: PREMIS
defined: PREMIS v3.0 semantic units for Objects (including Intellectual Entity as an Object category), Events, Agents, and Rights
tabs.implication: Preservation metadata only. Rights statements record rights information; they do not independently establish legal ownership. Track dictionary and schema versions separately and never equate validation with legal proof.
tabs.status: Library of Congress publishes PREMIS Data Dictionary v3.0 and errata; schema versions are separately listed.

tabs.title: W3C PROV-O
defined: PROV-O Entity, Activity, Agent classes and standard provenance properties/relations
tabs.implication: PROV-O expresses provenance relationships, not copyright allocation or truth. Preserve standard IRIs and relation direction; keep FR-0333 contribution and decision terms in a separate namespace.
tabs.status: W3C PROV-O is a W3C Recommendation dated 2013-04-30.

tabs.title: C2PA
defined: Version-specific C2PA manifest, claim, assertion, ingredient, signature, hard-binding, and validation concepts
tabs.implication: A valid signature can support integrity and signer-attribution checks under a trust policy; it does not alone prove copyright ownership, complete history, or truth of all assertions. Review spec, algorithm, assertion, trust-list, or validator changes; preserve original bytes and validation receipts.
tabs.status: C2PA specification portal exposes v2.4; record exact spec and validator versions for any future implementation.

tabs.title: BagIt
defined: RFC 8493 BagIt v1.0 package layout, payload/tag manifests, tag files, and checksum validation concepts
tabs.implication: BagIt packages files and records checksums for transfer/preservation; it does not establish authorship or ownership. Review checksum algorithms, tag handling, package validation rules, or path semantics that change import/export acceptance.
tabs.status: RFC 8493 defines BagIt v1.0 and explicitly is not an Internet Standards Track specification.

tabs.title: NDSA Levels
defined: NDSA Levels recommendations and supporting guidance for the cited version
tabs.implication: An assessment framework, not an interchange schema or ownership standard. Version 2.1 adds environmental sustainability guidance and revises some matrix text and working definitions; record the cited version and do not infer conformance from a local score.
tabs.status: NDSA lists Levels of Digital Preservation v2.1 as current.

tabs.title: Write Me
tabs.summary: On an explicitly requested review, capture issuer, source/version/date, and changed text/schema; compare with version pins and mapped fields; tag each change SOURCE_DEFINED or FR0333_EXTENSION; no mapped effect means REFERENCE + STAY; if affected, record impacted tab/fields, dual-read/migration needs, tests, rollback point, and HumanLock disposition. Do not edit the certificate or infer ownership from compatibility.

global_pins.rule: SOURCE_DEFINED != FR0333_EXTENSION; preserve both labels and namespaces.
METADATA != OWNERSHIP.ADJUDICATION; SIGNED != COMPLETE; FIXITY != AUTHORSHIP; COMPATIBLE != IMPLEMENTED.
SPECIFICATION.CANDIDATE != ENGINE.RUNTIME; promotion requires explicit HumanLock review.

evidence_boundary.dictionary_status: No standalone Creative Ownership dictionary was found in the engine tree; this is a versioned candidate.
